## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run --project ../PiyoAI/core python scripts/build_index.py` ran clean and I committed the updated `index.json`
- [ ] The skill asks for the fewest tools it needs, and `SKILL.md` explains why each is needed
- [ ] `SETUP.md` is a real guide (accounts, keys, folders), or says plainly that nothing needs setting up
- [ ] No keys, tokens or personal data anywhere in the package
- [ ] I did not edit `curation.json` (badges, categories and revocations are the maintainers' decision)
- [ ] The licence in `SKILL.md` is the licence of everything in the folder, and I have the right to publish it

## Anything the reviewer should look at twice

Scripts, network access, tools that send or change things, services whose terms limit automation.
